<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <defs>
    <filter id="shadow" x="-20%" y="-20%" width="140%" height="140%">
      <feDropShadow dx="0" dy="2" stdDeviation="3" flood-color="#DCDCDC" flood-opacity=".8"/>
    </filter>
  </defs>

  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#F3F2F7"/>

  <!-- Status bar -->
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="29" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <text x="20" y="19" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="12px" font-weight="700" fill="#110053">9:41</text>

  <line x1="341" y1="11" x2="341" y2="18" stroke="#110053" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="345" y1="9" x2="345" y2="18" stroke="#110053" stroke-width="2"/>
  <circle cx="327" cy="15" r="2" fill="#110053"/>
  <path d="M316 17 Q321 10 326 17" fill="none" stroke="#110053" stroke-width="1.5"/>

  <rect x="358" y="11" width="14" height="7" rx="1.5" fill="#0BAEAF"/>
  <rect x="377" y="12" width="2" height="5" rx="1" fill="#110053"/>

  <!-- Header -->
  <rect x="0" y="29" width="390" height="66" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <text x="22" y="55" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="21px" font-weight="700" fill="#110053">LATAM</text>
  <text x="22" y="77" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="14px" font-weight="400" fill="#5C5C5C">Viaja más, disfruta más</text>

  <circle cx="352" cy="54" r="6" fill="#9747FF"/>

  <circle cx="371" cy="43" r="5" fill="#EA104C"/>
  <text x="371" y="46" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="8px" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">2</text>

  <!-- Main heading -->
  <text x="20" y="123" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="21px" font-weight="700" fill="#110053">¿A dónde quieres ir?</text>
  <text x="20" y="145" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="14px" font-weight="400" fill="#5C5C5C">Encuentra tu próximo viaje</text>

  <!-- Segmented travel categories -->
  <g>
    <rect x="20" y="160" width="108" height="36" rx="100" fill="#110053"/>
    <text x="74" y="183" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="14px" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">Vuelos</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <rect x="139" y="160" width="108" height="36" rx="100" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#D1D1D2"/>
    <text x="193" y="183" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="14px" font-weight="700" fill="#110053">Hoteles</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <rect x="258" y="160" width="108" height="36" rx="100" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#D1D1D2"/>
    <text x="312" y="183" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="14px" font-weight="700" fill="#110053">Autos</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Search card -->
  <g filter="url(#shadow)">
    <rect x="14" y="214" width="362" height="464" rx="14" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Trip type -->
  <text x="29" y="239" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="13px" font-weight="700" fill="#110053">Tipo de viaje</text>
  <g>
    <rect x="29" y="247" width="165" height="34" rx="7" fill="#EFEDFA" stroke="#9747FF"/>
    <circle cx="47" cy="264" r="6" fill="#9747FF"/>
    <circle cx="47" cy="264" r="2.5" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <text x="61" y="269" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="13px" font-weight="700" fill="#110053">Ida y vuelta</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <rect x="202" y="247" width="158" height="34" rx="7" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#B6B6B6"/>
    <circle cx="220" cy="264" r="6" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#B6B6B6"/>
    <text x="234" y="269" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="13px" font-weight="400" fill="#5C5C5C">Solo ida</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Origin and destination -->
  <text x="29" y="307" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="13px" font-weight="700" fill="#110053">Origen y destino</text>
  <g>
    <rect x="29" y="315" width="332" height="52" rx="7" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#B6B6B6"/>

    <text x="66" y="334" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="11px" font-weight="400" fill="#5C5C5C">Origen</text>
    <text x="66" y="353" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="15px" font-weight="700" fill="#110053">Santiago (SCL)</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <rect x="29" y="375" width="332" height="52" rx="7" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#B6B6B6"/>
    <circle cx="48" cy="394" r="5" fill="#EA104C"/>
    <line x1="48" y1="401" x2="48" y2="410" stroke="#EA104C" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="66" y="394" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="11px" font-weight="400" fill="#5C5C5C">Destino</text>
    <text x="66" y="413" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="15px" font-weight="700" fill="#110053">Buenos Aires (EZE)</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <rect x="326" y="350" width="31" height="31" rx="100" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#EA104C"/>
    <line x1="335" y1="360" x2="348" y2="373" stroke="#EA104C" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="348" y1="360" x2="335" y2="373" stroke="#EA104C" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  </g>

  <text x="29" y="453" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="13px" font-weight="700" fill="#110053">Fechas</text>
  <g>
    <rect x="29" y="461" width="160" height="52" rx="7" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#B6B6B6"/>
    <rect x="45" y="476" width="16" height="15" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#9747FF" stroke-width="1.5"/>

    <line x1="49" y1="472" x2="49" y2="478" stroke="#9747FF" stroke-width="1.5"/>

    <text x="73" y="499" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="14px" font-weight="700" fill="#110053">12 ago 2025</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <rect x="201" y="461" width="160" height="52" rx="7" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#B6B6B6"/>
    <rect x="217" y="476" width="16" height="15" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#9747FF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="217" y1="480" x2="233" y2="480" stroke="#9747FF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="221" y1="472" x2="221" y2="478" stroke="#9747FF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="229" y1="472" x2="229" y2="478" stroke="#9747FF" stroke-width="1.5"/>

    <text x="245" y="499" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="14px" font-weight="700" fill="#110053">20 ago 2025</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Passengers -->
  <text x="29" y="539" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="13px" font-weight="700" fill="#110053">Pasajeros y cabina</text>
  <g>
    <rect x="29" y="547" width="204" height="52" rx="7" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#B6B6B6"/>
    <circle cx="49" cy="567" r="5" fill="none" stroke="#9747FF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <ellipse cx="49" cy="579" rx="9" ry="5" fill="none" stroke="#9747FF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="68" y="570" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="14px" font-weight="700" fill="#110053">1 adulto</text>
    <text x="68" y="587" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="11px" font-weight="400" fill="#5C5C5C">Económica</text>
    <polyline points="210,570 215,575 220,570" fill="none" stroke="#110053" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  </g>
  <g>
    <rect x="245" y="547" width="116" height="52" rx="7" fill="#EFEDFA"/>
    <text x="303" y="569" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="11px" font-weight="400" fill="#5C5C5C">Código promo</text>
    <text x="303" y="588" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="13px" font-weight="700" fill="#9747FF">Agregar</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Preferences -->
  <rect x="29" y="615" width="16" height="16" rx="3" fill="#9747FF"/>
  <polyline points="33,623 37,627 42,619" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.8"/>
  <text x="54" y="628" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="12px" font-weight="400" fill="#5C5C5C">Buscar vuelos con equipaje incluido</text>
  <text x="29" y="650" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="11px" font-weight="400" fill="#5C5C5C">Podrás revisar y cambiar tus preferencias antes de pagar.</text>

  <g>
    <rect x="29" y="660" width="332" height="51" rx="7" fill="#EA104C"/>
    <text x="183" y="692" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="17px" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">Buscar vuelos</text>
    <circle cx="324" cy="685" r="8" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <line x1="330" y1="691" x2="336" y2="697" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.7"/>
  </g>

  <g>
    <rect x="18" y="724" width="354" height="46" rx="7" fill="#EFEDFA"/>
    <circle cx="39" cy="747" r="10" fill="#4658E0"/>
    <text x="39" y="751" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="13px" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">i</text>
    <text x="57" y="743" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="12px" font-weight="700" fill="#110053">¿Necesitas ayuda?</text>
    <text x="57" y="760" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="11px" font-weight="400" fill="#5C5C5C">Consulta nuestras opciones de viaje.</text>
    <polyline points="345,742 350,747 345,752" fill="none" stroke="#9747FF" stroke-width="2"/>
  </g>

  <rect x="0" y="785" width="390" height="59" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <line x1="0" y1="785" x2="390" y2="785" stroke="#E0E0E2"/>
  <g>
    <polygon points="38,807 48,798 58,807" fill="#110053"/>
    <rect x="42" y="806" width="12" height="11" fill="#110053"/>
    <text x="48" y="835" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="10px" font-weight="700" fill="#110053">Inicio</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <rect x="124" y="800" width="18" height="15" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#5C5C5C" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <line x1="128" y1="797" x2="128" y2="803" stroke="#5C5C5C" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="138" y1="797" x2="138" y2="803" stroke="#5C5C5C" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="133" y="835" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="10px" font-weight="400" fill="#5C5C5C">Mis viajes</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <circle cx="235" cy="806" r="9" fill="none" stroke="#5C5C5C" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <line x1="242" y1="813" x2="248" y2="819" stroke="#5C5C5C" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <text x="235" y="835" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="10px" font-weight="400" fill="#5C5C5C">Explorar</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <circle cx="337" cy="802" r="5" fill="none" stroke="#5C5C5C" stroke-width="1.6"/>
    <ellipse cx="337" cy="815" rx="9" ry="5" fill="none" stroke="#5C5C5C" stroke-width="1.6"/>
    <text x="337" y="835" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="10px" font-weight="400" fill="#5C5C5C">Cuenta</text>
  </g>
</svg>
